pilot_status.note: KO is the lower-drift restraint case inside this bounded case view. The visible comparison intentionally stays one-read so the app can show restraint rather than fabricate extra compare lanes.

takeaways: KO shows that the product can still surface useful filing signal when the pair is mostly stable and selectively sharpened.
Keeping the visible comparison centered on the primary read avoids panel sprawl and keeps the restraint case legible.
Fresh vs reused remains available below as a compact secondary check rather than becoming a peer read in the comparison.
caveats: This is a bounded single-issuer, single-pair restraint-case view, not a benchmark.
The absence of visible comparison, secondary, and control reads is intentional and should be read as product discipline, not missing hidden winners.
Claims here improve credibility beyond vivid cases, but they do not justify broad issuer expansion, overlays, or equal-weight promotion of Fresh vs reused.
